# Bat Cave Road Farm

> Family-owned farm in Old Fort, North Carolina (near Asheville) with a hands-on petting zoo, a seasonal farmstand, and an on-farm thrift shop. Founded 2023. Open Tuesday-Sunday, 10:00 AM-4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.

## Key facts

- Address: 4132 Bat Cave Road, Old Fort, NC 28762, USA
- Phone: (828) 216-5488
- Email: support@batcaveroadfarm.com
- Hours (all areas): Tuesday-Sunday, 10:00 AM-4:00 PM. Closed Mondays.
- Petting zoo appointments recommended - call (828) 216-5488.
- Payment: cash, credit/debit card, Venmo, PayPal, Cash App
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/batcaveroadfarm
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/batcaveroadfarm

## Visit

- [Plan Your Visit](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/plan-your-visit/): what to expect, hours, and tips
- [Map & Directions](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/directions/): driving directions to the farm

- [Annual Passes](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/passes/): year-round visits
- [Book a Group](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/booking/): schools, groups, and appointments
- [Private Events](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/private-events/): parties and private bookings
- [Events](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/events/): seasonal happenings on the farm

## What we offer

- [Petting Zoo](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/petting-zoo/): goats, pigs, white peacocks, a donkey, ducks and ducklings, sheep, rabbits, and chickens. Feed is sold by staff (farm feed only).
- [Farm Stand](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/farm-stand/): seasonal vegetables, sourdough bread, farm eggs, local honey, jams, pickles, and cut flowers
- [Thrift Shop](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/thrift-shop/): vintage, antiques, collectibles, and one-of-a-kind finds. [Current items](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/thrift-shop/items/)
- [Shop](https://batcaveroadfarm.com/shop/): online store
